title: slides
description: Slides to show one at a time, each as large as the screen: down, one under the next and moved by the scroll, or across, side by side and moved by the ← and → keys or a swipe; a cover of the title, then slides of a heading over parts, a slide of a heading alone standing between parts of the talk.

direction.description: How the slides are laid out and moved: down (when left out), one under the next, moved by the scroll; across, side by side, moved by the ← and → keys or a swipe

subtitle.description: A line under the title on the cover, such as who speaks and when; a line of Markdown

parts.description: The parts of the slide, as report's; left out, the slide is a heading alone, between parts of the talk
